text:
Maya: Quick sync 1: we're doing a small A/B on the benchmark launch social push next Tue. Need X + LinkedIn variants, image + GIF specs, and SDR routing. Who can own scheduling and the A/B tags?

Noah: I can run scheduling and A/B. Planning: control thread + performance-focused thread. Need 2 short intros, 1 carousel variant, and a LinkedIn TL;DR. ETA copy by 3pm.

Ashley: I'll output assets in 1200x628 and 1080x1080, plus a 2s loop GIF and a 16:9 cover for LinkedIn. Uploading to /Marketing/BenchLaunch/Assets. Link when done.

Sam: SDR routing proposal: form -> /leads/bench-2026, tag=organic_social, owner=growth-rotations. Add UTM: utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=bench_launch_ab. Also create tag retarget=paid_lookalike for later.

Maya: good. Noah add the UTM strings per variant and include an A/B param (ab_group=A or B). Also schedule a 48h follow-up Q&A thread and a retarget CTA 72h after.

Noah: Draft copy:
Variant A (control):
"New benchmark: 3x throughput, lower unit cost. Read the report -> link"
Variant B (technical):
"Under the hood: batching + KV caching cut ops 40% on our runtime. Repro configs inside."
Carousel variant idea: slides: key metric, methodology, configs, TL;DR.
Schedule proposal:
- Tue 10:00 PT: X main thread (Variant A)
- Tue 10:10 PT: LinkedIn TL;DR + 16:9 cover
- Tue 13:00 PT: X carousel (Variant B)
- Thu 10:00 PT (48h): Live Q&A announce
- Fri 10:00 PT (72h): Retarget CTA post

Ashley: Assets uploaded: hero_1200x628.png, hero_1080.png, bench_loop_2s.gif, linkedin_cover_16x9.png -> share link https://drive.google.com/example_new_assets

Emmy: I'll run an engagement push for the first 6 hours: seed comments, pin top comment, and monitor responses. Need 2 seed comments per variant and instructions for community managers.

Maya: @Emmy please draft seeds. @SDR Bot create rule bench_launch_ab -> assign Growth SDR pool, priority=high, tag=ab_test.

SDR Bot: Created routing rule bench_launch_ab -> Growth SDR pool, priority=high, tags=[organic_social, ab_test]. :white_check_mark:

Noah: Seed comments (examples):
1) "Huge shout to the infra crew 1 This will change cost per inference."
2) "Does anyone want the exact config we ran? It's in the repo."

Maya: Community manager note: reply to top questions with link to appendix, escalate demo requests to SDRs, pin the most helpful comment. Keep replies <2 sentences.

Sam: SDR quick scripts:
- <30m: Intro email w/ report link, 2 tailored bullets, CTA to schedule demo.
- <24h: If MQL, move to demo pipeline.
- 3 tries no response: tag nurture + enroll drip.
Include note to reference ab_group param if present.

ops-bot: Reminder: use /schedule-post to avoid rate limit issues and add A/B tag in scheduling metadata.

Maya: final asks: Noah, include UTM+ab tags; Ashley, confirm file sizes; Emmy, prep seed comments and DM community managers; Sam, paste full SDR template into the playbook doc. We'll meet Tue 09:30 PT for pre-launch check. :rocket:
